articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on doctoral-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap toward robust autonomous agent capabilities.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Near-Human Performance on Graduate-Level Math Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored 92% on a curated set of International Mathematical Olympiad problems using a novel neuro-symbolic reasoning architecture. The system combines large-scale transformer inference with formal proof verification, representing a major step toward AI systems that can reliably produce verifiable mathematical proofs.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in select Gigafactory production lines for material handling and component inspection tasks. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22 degrees of freedom per hand and on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation without explicit reprogramming.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Construction Site Autonomy
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics revealed the commercial version of its electric Atlas humanoid robot, purpose-built for construction environments with IP67 ruggedization and 4-hour continuous operation. Paired with Hyundai's autonomous heavy equipment ecosystem, the platform can autonomously perform rebar placement, site surveying, and debris clearing with minimal human supervision.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Oversight Framework Adopted by EU AI Office
articles.summary: Anthropic published a comprehensive constitutional AI oversight framework that the EU AI Office has formally endorsed as a reference implementation for high-risk AI system compliance under the AI Act. The framework includes automated red-teaming pipelines, interpretability dashboards, and continuous alignment monitoring, offering a practical blueprint for regulatory-grade AI governance.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Transistor Chips
articles.summary: TSMC announced the start of volume production on its N1.4 process node using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors, delivering a 25% performance improvement and 35% power reduction over its 2nm node. Early customers include Apple, Nvidia, and AMD, with the node expected to power next-generation AI accelerators and mobile SoCs shipping in early 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Correction Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly demonstrated sustained fault-tolerant operations on 32 logical qubits with error rates below the threshold needed for practical quantum error correction. The breakthrough, achieved on Quantinuum's H3 trapped-ion system using Microsoft's topological error-correction codes, puts commercially useful quantum computation on a credible five-year timeline.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Production for Warehouse Logistics
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by Bezos Expeditions and Intel Capital, valuing the company at $12 billion. The funding will be used to build a dedicated manufacturing facility targeting annual production of 10,000 Figure 03 humanoid units optimized for warehouse pick-and-pack operations, with BMW and Amazon as anchor customers.
